name: impact
description: Live unit testing for .NET in VS Code — save a file, affected tests go green or red in ~50ms. Hot-patched warm test hosts, IL impact map, native Test Explorer. CLI included for pre-commit hooks and AI coding agents.

dotnetImpact.autoBuildMap.description: Automatically build/refresh the impact map in the background when a workspace opens and unmapped test classes exist.

dotnetImpact.persistentTestSessions.description: Keep vstest test sessions (pre-warmed testhosts) alive between runs so incremental runs skip process startup. Falls back to plain dotnet test when unavailable.

dotnetImpact.liveMapRefresh.description: After each affected run, re-collect coverage for the classes that ran (low-priority, background) so map rows stay fresh.

dotnetImpact.warmCoverageRefresh.description: Collect live map-refresh coverage through a resident dotnet-coverage session with instrumented warm testhosts (~3x faster per class). Installs the dotnet-coverage tool on first use; falls back to per-class collector runs when unavailable.

dotnetImpact.surfaceBuildWarnings.description: Surface compiler warnings from builds as squigglies. Build errors are always shown. "auto" shows warnings only when the C# extension (ms-dotnettools.csharp) is not installed — its language server already provides live warnings, and doubling them up would duplicate squigglies.

dotnetImpact.autoRunOnSave.description: Run affected tests automatically when a .cs file is saved.

dotnetImpact.watchExternalChanges.description: Also trigger affected runs when files change on disk without an editor save (git checkout/pull/revert, scripts, other editors). Files with unsaved editors are ignored; bursts run as one batch.

dotnetImpact.externalDebounceMs.description: Burst window for external file changes: a git operation touching many files collects into a single run this long after its last event.

dotnetImpact.debounceMs.description: Debounce interval after the last save before running affected tests.

dotnetImpact.testProjectGlobs.description: Globs used to identify test projects.

dotnetImpact.dotnetPath.description: Full path to the dotnet executable. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH, DOTNET_ROOT, ~/.dotnet, system install locations).

dotnetImpact.maxParallelCoverageRuns.description: Concurrent 'dotnet test --list-tests' runs during test discovery. 0 = auto (cores minus 2, max 12). Map building itself is static analysis and needs no throttle.
